promptAsSent:
Use the image_gen tool to generate exactly one image, then stop. Do not write files, run commands or edit anything.

Attached reference images, in order:
Image 1: Geometry/layout authority and edit target: keep every silhouette, position and size
Image 2: Painting style and rendering finish only; not layout, not material colour

Use case: sketch-to-render, game sprite sheet. Image 1 is the authoritative geometry guide and edit target: reskin it, keeping every shape exactly where and how big it is on the 1536x1024 canvas. It holds two separate objects for a heavy ground-defence hardpoint of a top-down tactical game, each seen from directly above. Left: a raised gun plinth about one storey (four metres) tall, seen from straight above, so its sloped battered side walls show as the four bands round the flat top deck: the north and west walls catch the sun and are light, the south and east walls are in shade and dark; it must read clearly as a tall solid block standing above the ground. A narrow staircase is cut into the south wall from the deck down to the ground (keep the steps as drawn), a low parapet rims the deck, small lockers or vents sit on three deck corners, and the deck holds an empty dark circular turret-ring well (leave the well dark and plain: a separate gun house sits over it). Right: the heavy anti-armour gun house that sits on it: an armoured turret with one long heavy barrel and muzzle brake pointing straight up the image, a cupola, a roof hatch and rear stowage bustle. Material and style: Industrial colony steel: riveted and bolted dark gunmetal and galvanised steel plate, checker-plate and grating, worn yellow-and-black hazard striping where the guide shows the bright ring and on stair edges, rust at seams, oil stains; gun heads in scuffed gunmetal grey with safety-orange accents on hatches and fittings. Straight 90-degree overhead orthographic camera, top-down like a strategy-game map sprite, no perspective tilt. Sun from the upper left: keep the guide's lit and shaded faces exactly where they are. Hand-painted gritty dark-science-fiction game-sprite look like Starsector, restrained desaturated palette, coarse readable detail that survives being shrunk to about 30 to 40 pixels per cell. No text, no labels, no watermark, no UI, no ground or terrain, no grass, no cast shadow outside the objects, no extra slab, apron or border. Transparent background outside every silhouette (if transparency is impossible, a flat pure white background). Change only material, surface detail and subtle shading, never placement, size or silhouette.
